title: AI-LIEDAR : Examine the Trade-off Between Utility and Truthfulness in LLM Agents
reasoning: The paper introduces AI-LIEDAR, a framework to evaluate how LLMs navigate the ethical and moral trade-off between truthfulness (honesty) and utility (goal achievement). It includes a dedicated section on 'Machine Morality' and tests models in 'morally-charged situations' specifically involving deceptive behaviors.
